description: Public FlightAware flight page for one flight number: airline, aircraft type, origin and destination airports (IATA, name), status (e.g. arrived, en route) and the flight ident. Read from the JSON embedded in the public page; no login. Live altitude and speed are not included on the page used. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ident.description: Flight number such as UAL956 (2 to 8 letters and digits)
